subject: Hosted evaluation: deployment suitability, quickstart endpoints, and rate asks
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@cleargate.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation: deployment suitability, quickstart endpoints, and rate asks

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can map you to the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC). I captured the high-level notes during the call and added specific asks we need to size the pilot: 

Summary from call:
- ClearGate: real-time document enrichment for underwriting (PII present in ~30% of payloads)
- Primary need: low-latency scoring (sub-250ms median for inference) with occasional peaks during batch ingestion windows
- Current infra: cloud-hosted app in us-west, would like either Hosted API with VPC peering or Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput

Questions / info we need to recommend the right path:
1) Security & residency: do you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or is per-tenant encryption in-hosted acceptable for pilot?
2) Traffic profile: please confirm expected concurrent requests (p95 concurrency), typical tokens/request, and peak qps during underwriting spikes. The attached sample is helpful — we may need a full CSV of 2 weeks.
3) SLA tolerance: is 99.9% acceptable for Hosted? Or do you need contractual SLAs (Dedicated / Private)?
4) Endpoint mapping: will you be using a single combined chat endpoint or separate endpoints (classification/scoring + embeddings)?
5) Data retention / audit: any retention limits or logging restrictions we should know about for compliance?

Proposed quickstart (what we can provision fast under Hosted):
- Sandbox: 2 endpoints (scoring + embeddings), low-cost sandbox keys for integration tests
- Canary Prod: 1 canary endpoint behind a rate-slice (baseline 20 req/s, burst to 200 req/s for short windows)
- Prefetch/kv suggestions for repeated prompts to reduce per-token cost

Action items I propose from our side:
- SE (Soogin/Jordan) to validate feasibility of the above and send a ratecap + cost estimate
- Security to confirm if hosted meets ClearGate requirements or if Private/Dedicated is necessary

If Hosted with optional VPC peering meets your requirements, we can stand up the sandbox within 3 business days. If Dedicated or Private is required, that timeline changes (we'll outline next steps).

Attached: cleargate_traffic_sample.csv (sanitized).

Would you be able to confirm the 5 questions above and share a fuller traffic export by EOD Friday?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: cleargate_traffic_sample.csv (csv, 42 KB) — sample traffic with tokens/request and timestamp columns
From: Ellen Park <ellen@cleargate.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: deployment suitability, quickstart endpoints, and rate asks

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few answers inline, and a couple follow-up asks from our side: 

1) KMS/HSM: For pilot, we can accept platform-managed encryption but production will require customer-managed KMS. Important to know for design.
2) Traffic profile: Peak expected ~800 requests/min (13.3 qps) across our scoring endpoint during batch windows; p95 concurrency ~18. Typical tokens/request ~280–360 (median ~320).
3) SLA: We prefer 99.95% for production, but 99.9% is OK to start for a hosted pilot — we expect to revisit for Dedicated or Private at go-live.
4) Endpoints: We plan to keep scoring + embeddings as separate endpoints. We also want a light metadata lookup endpoint for quick enrichments (~50ms target).
5) Retention: Minimal retention requirements for logs; we need full access to audit logs for the 90-day retention window.

Other asks:
- Can you provide a quick cost estimate for the sandbox + a 30-day production pilot under Hosted (with the above traffic characteristics)?
- Does Redwood support VPC peering for Hosted, so traffic stays within our cloud account?

We attached a cleaned traffic export (same file you have but with full 2-week duration). Happy to hop on a 30-min session if helpful.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Product — ClearGate AI
ellen@cleargate.ai | (206) 555-3189

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: deployment suitability, quickstart endpoints, and rate asks

Hi Ellen / Naomi —

Thanks for the profile and the longer export — that's exactly what we need to size the pilot. A few technical notes and recommendations based on the numbers you shared: 

- Hosted with optional VPC peering: we can support VPC peering for traffic egress (keeps traffic within your cloud account) and platform-managed encryption for the pilot. For customer-managed KMS in production, we recommend Redwood Private or a Dedicated setup with KMS integration.
- Throughput & endpoints: Given a p95 concurrency ~18 and tokens/request ~320, Hosted sandbox can support your peaks if we map endpoints and enable prefix KV caching for repeated templates. Suggested mapping: scoring endpoint (primary), embeddings endpoint (secondary), and a small metadata lookup endpoint (light CPU path).
- Rate slicing: Recommend baseline slice of 20 req/s for canary with a burst policy to 200 req/s for short windows (5–10 minutes) to cover ingestion spikes — this matches the proposed quickstart. If you need consistent 13 qps sustained per scoring endpoint during peaks, we should reserve a dedicate compute slice (Dedicated) or discuss guaranteed throughput on Dedicated nodes.
- Latency: sub-250ms median is achievable for scoring if sequence lengths average <=400 tokens and KV cache hits are high. We'll instrument tracing in the sandbox to validate.
- Pre-warm: we can pre-warm model kernels for your 30-minute ingestion windows to reduce tail latencies — requires a small warm-up run before scheduled batches.

I attached a short sample config we would deploy for the sandbox (endpoint mapping + rate slices). If Hosted is acceptable for pilot and you can tolerate platform-managed KMS for now, we can spin the sandbox in 48–72 hours. For production KMS/HSM or a contractual 99.95% SLA, we'll need to evaluate Dedicated or Private.

I'll follow up with a draft ratecap + cost estimate and a proposed MAP by EOD today.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference

2) Naomi — submit the hosted pilot order and coordinate sandbox provisioning once SE config is approved.
3) ClearGate (Ellen) — share the full 2-week traffic CSV (you already attached; please confirm final file) and confirm whether platform-managed KMS is acceptable for pilot.
4) Legal/Security (Redwood) — share a short security brief and audit/logging approach; Naomi will loop in security if ClearGate requests KMS for pilot.

Meeting: proposed 30-min sync to review estimates and confirm sandbox mapping — Wed, Sep 15 at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm availability.

Thanks again — we'll aim to have the sandbox live within 48–72 hours pending your confirmation on KMS.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
